verdict.rationale: A public library of starter workflows or samples is a fair ask for a workflow orchestration platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a template or sample gallery. The only nearby items are a getting-started walkthrough (temporal-docs-31) and a passing mention of viewing 'sample workflows' in the Web UI (temporal-gh-2), and neither describes a reusable template library. Temporal also describes itself as Workflows-as-Code rather than no-code (temporal-docs-11).
